title: 0v3x decal spam f3x
script:
local remote

for _, t in pairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
    if t:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI") then
        remote = t.SyncAPI.ServerEndpoint
    end
end

for _, t in pairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:GetChildren()) do
    if t:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI") then
        remote = t.SyncAPI.ServerEndpoint
    end
end

if not remote then return end

local id = "82935711171924"

local function addDecals(part)
    for _, face in pairs({0,1,2,3,4,5}) do
        pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, "CreateTextures", {{Part = part, Face = face, TextureType = "Decal"}})
        pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, "SyncTexture", {{Part = part, Face = face, TextureType = "Decal", Texture = "rbxassetid://" .. id}})
    end
end

local function spam()
    for _, v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("BasePart") or v:IsA("MeshPart") or v:IsA("UnionOperation") then
            task.spawn(addDecals, v)
        end
    end
end

for i=1,5 do spam() end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.5)
        spam()
    end
end)
